actual.titulo: Documentary 360 • Toki: Return of an Extinct Bird
actual.descripcion: Toki: Return of an Extinct Bird | Once extinct in Japan, the toki has been reintroduced; today, nearly 500 of these birds live in the wild; cameras follow them throughout the four seasons, along with their human helpers.
